task:
Write a {lang} program that reads all of stdin, splits it into whitespace-separated words, and prints exactly one line:
words=<count> distinct=<distinct-count>
Single file, standard library only, no explanation — output the file contents only.
sample_input: the quick brown fox the fox

contract_problems: uses require() in an ES module (.mjs)

results.code:
import sys

def count_words_and_distinct():
    input_data = sys.stdin.read()
    words = input_data.split()
    word_count = len(words)
    distinct_word_count = len(set(words))
    print(f"words={word_count} distinct={distinct_word_count}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    count_words_and_distinct()
